|lore=“Chisa nyooda ishaley. Kun Jabba neguda len malta.” “Ikkit ui! Yobbit, yobbit. Nelan tui ke bada.”
|game_text=Deploy on Imperial City. While Agents Of Black Sun or Vengeance Of The Dark Prince also on table, Scum And Villainy may deploy here and may not be canceled if a Black Sun agent is present. Once per turn you may ▼ one non-weapon card with Xizor or Black Sun in its lore.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Information Exchange (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire]], in date order (3 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Information Exchange (V) (Virtual Set 7)]]): first release sheet “Virtual Set #7” (Players Committee; set released 16 July 2004; PDF dated 17 July 2004), page 2, slip 17 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040730074404/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf VirtualCards7.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 30 July 2004), linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040922081946/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's home page]: “Deploy on Imperial City. While Agents Of The Black Sun or Vengeance Of The Dark Prince also on table, Scum And Villainy may deploy here and may not be canceled if a Black Sun agent is present. Once per turn you may ▼ one non-weapon card with Xizor or Black Sun in its lore.” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “7•17” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the updated sheet of 12 October 2004 (“Updated 10/12/04”; [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205104319/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%207.pdf Virtual Set 7.pdf] on swccgpc.com, Internet Archive 5 December 2004; PDF dated 12 October 2004), page 2, slip 17, on the same old slip: “Deploy on Imperial City. While Agents Of Black Sun or Vengeance Of The Dark Prince also on table, Scum And Villainy may deploy here and may not be canceled if a Black Sun agent is present. Once per turn you may ▼ one non-weapon card with Xizor or Black Sun in its lore.” '''What changed:''' “The” was removed.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Information Exchange (V) (Virtual Set 7) (Errata 2)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143103/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards7.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007], slip 17), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on Imperial City. While your [Reflections2] objective on table, Scum And Villainy may deploy here and, if a Black Sun agent present, may not be canceled. During your deploy phase, may deploy a non-weapon card with “Black Sun” or “Xizor” in lore from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
